description: Find a person's verified work email by first name, last name and company domain, via Prospeo's person-enrichment API. Returns the email only when Prospeo actually reveals and verifies it — a masked/unrevealed guess is reported as not found rather than handed back as an address. Example: prospeo_find_email({ first_name: "Patrick", last_name: "Collison", domain: "stripe.com", _apiKey: "your-prospeo-key" })

_apiKey.description: Your Prospeo API key (get one at app.prospeo.io/api).

company_name.description: Optional company name, used if Prospeo cannot resolve from the domain alone.

name: prospeo_find_email
title: Prospeo Find Email
